customer: Hi there, I'm a college student in Eastvale hoping to sell my pickup truck to help cover tuition. The truck has a rebuilt title since it was in an accident a few years before I bought it. Would Northwind still be able to make me an offer?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry to be the bearer of disappointing news. As explained in our Salvage and rebuilt titles article, a branded title means the vehicle was declared a total loss and possibly rebuilt afterward. Northwind doesn't buy cars with salvage, rebuilt or flood titles, so we're unable to make an offer on your truck.
